plan.title: Zebrafish larvae treated vs control DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: Gene-level Salmon counts (12000 genes x 6 samples) with a 3 treated vs 3 control zebrafish larva design. Pipeline: blind sample-structure QC (vst PCA, distances, library sizes) to confirm grouping and spot outliers; minimal low-count pre-filter; DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization inside a ~condition model with control as the explicit reference; Wald test with apeglm-shrunken LFCs, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering. Because Danio rerio has no curated gene set collection here, the full ranked list (Wald statistic) is mapped to human one-to-one orthologs with babelgene and tested with fgsea against the staged WikiPathways human GMT; genes without a one-to-one ortholog drop out and the mapped share is reported. Report carries the power statement required at n=3 per group.
